有效淨現金流（非香港財務報告會計             EFFECTIVE NET CASH FLOW (NON-
準則計量）                        HKFRS ACCOUNTING STANDARDS
                             MEASURE)
為補充根據香港財務報告會計準則編製之綜合財        To supplement the consolidated financial statements,
務報表，本集團亦採用「有效淨現金流」作為附        which are presented in accordance with HKFRS
加財務計量指標。該指標並非香港財務報告會計        Accounting standards, the Group also use “effective
準則所界定或呈列，旨在通過對比核心淨利潤與        net cash flow” as an additional financial measure. This
現金流，為投資者及管理層提供有關本集團業績        measure is not defined or presented under HKFRS
質量的有用參考。                     Accounting standards, which is intended to provide
                             investors and the management with a useful reference on
                             the quality of the Group’s results by comparing core net
                             profit with cash flow.


本集團將有效淨現金流界定為：經營活動所得現        The Group defines the effective net cash flow as: net cash
金淨額，經調整還原併購項目化債對抵的經營欠        generated from operating activities, adjusted to reinstate
款影響，並計入核心淨利潤口徑下的利息流入後        the effect of operating receivables offset against debt
的現金流狀況。其中，併購化債對抵的經營欠款        assumed in acquisitions, and incorporating the cash flow
指本集團在併購化債中，以應付股轉款對抵應收        position after interest inflows under the core net profit
經營欠款。該抵銷處理導致本集團投資活動現金        measurement. Among them, operating receivables offset
流流出及經營活動現金流流入同時減少。管理層        against debt assumed in acquisitions refer to operating
認為，將該部分款項還原至經營活動，能更準確        receivables offset by the Group against share transfer
地反映本集團真實的現金創造能力。             payables in debt assumption transactions. Such offsetting
                             treatment results in a simultaneous reduction in both
                             cash outflows from investing activities and cash inflows
                             from operating activities of the Group. The management
                             is of the view that reinstating such amounts to operating
                             activities can more accurately reflect the Group’s actual
                             cash-generating ability.

           收益率與黃金現貨價格掛鈎，且其標                            yield of these structured deposits linked to the
           的價格為黃金現貨市場的交易價格。                            spot price of gold, and the price of its indicator is
           該等合約產生的現金流量並非僅為對                            the transaction price of the spot market of gold.
           支付本金及未償還本金利息的付款。                            The cash flows arising from these contracts are
           因此，結構性存款入賬列作按公允價                            not solely for payments of principal and interest
           值計量且其變動計入當期損益的金融                            on the principal amount outstanding. For such
           資產。                                         purpose, the structured deposits are accounted for
                                                       as financial assets measured at fair value through
                                                       profit or loss.

     (b)   理財產品為金融機構發行的金融基金                   (b)      Wealth management products are investments
           投資。理財產品的合約條款於特定日                            in financial funds issued by financial institutions.
           期產生的現金流量並非僅為對本金及                            The contractual terms of the wealth management
           未償還本金利息的付款。因此，該等                            product give rise to cash flows on specified
           產品分類為按公允價值計量且其變動                            dates that are not solely payments of principal
           計入當期損益的金融資產。                                and interest on the principal amount outstanding.
                                                       Accordingly, these products are classified as
                                                       financial assets measured at fair value through
                                                       profit or loss.

     報表呈列及披露                     in financial statements
     香港財務報告準則第 18 號將取代香港會        HKFRS 18 will replace HKAS 1 Presentation of
     計準則第1 號財務報表的呈列並旨在改善         financial statements and aims to improve the
     實體的財務報表資料的透明性及可比較           transparency and comparability of information
     性。香港財務報告準則第 18 號於二零二        about an entity’s financial statements. HKFRS 18
     七年一月一日或之後開始的年度報告期間          is effective for annual reporting periods beginning
     生效，並須追溯應用。                  on or after 1 January 2027 and is to be applied
                                 retrospectively.


     除其他變動外，根據香港財務報告準則第          Among other changes, under HKFRS 18, entities
     18 號，實體須在損益表中將所有收入及         are required to classify all income and expenses
     支出分類為五個類別，即經營、投資、融          into five categories in the statement of profit or
     資、已終止經營業務及所得稅類別。實體          loss, namely the operating, investing, financing,
     亦須在財務報表的單一附註中就管理層界          discontinued operations and income tax
     定的績效指標提供具體披露。               categories. Entities are also required to provide
                                 specific disclosures about management-defined
                                 performance measures in a single note in the
                                 financial statements.


     本集團無意提早採納香港財務報告準則第          The Group does not plan to early adopt HKFRS 18
